Beratung.title: Psychological counselling
Beratung.intro: Better understand thoughts, feelings and patterns of behaviour – and derive new possibilities for action. Counselling is aimed at adults facing personal or professional challenges, a wish for change, or questions of life.

Ablauf.title: How counselling works
Ablauf.closing: The steps are deliberately simple. You, your questions and your pace are at the centre.

0.title: Contact
0.text: You get in touch with no obligation. In a short exchange we clarify whether and how counselling might fit your situation.

1.title: Understanding
1.text: In conversation we jointly make sense of what moves you – thoughts, feelings, patterns and the context of your everyday life.

2.title: Your own paths
2.text: From this, new perspectives and concrete possibilities for action emerge that you can pursue at your own pace.

Ansatz.title: Understand what moves you. Shape what is possible.
Ansatz.p1: Counselling connects scientifically grounded psychology with philosophical reflection as well as resource- and solution-oriented approaches. Clarity, resilience and concrete next steps take centre stage.
Ansatz.p2: It is not about analysing problems endlessly. Together we understand what moves you, embrace what is, and develop possibilities for action that fit your situation – calmly, respectfully and on equal footing.

UeberMich.imageAlt: Tam Nguyen, Psychologist lic. phil., portrait
UeberMich.p1: I completed my studies in psychology at the University of Bern with the Lizentiat. My focus areas were work and organisational psychology as well as clinical psychology.
UeberMich.p2: Over many years I have accompanied people and teams in companies as well as with personal concerns, including in international and intercultural contexts. These experiences have sharpened my eye for how differently people think, feel and deal with challenges.
UeberMich.p3: My aim is not to prescribe ready-made answers or paths, but to understand together what moves you, to embrace what is, and from there to develop new possibilities for action.

Legal.privacyIntro: This privacy policy informs you about the processing of personal data in connection with the website WeitSinn.ch (psychological counselling, Tam Nguyen) under the Swiss Data Protection Act (FADP).
Legal.purposeText: The website provides information about the psychological counselling offer and enables contact. No online bookings and no online payments are offered.
Legal.contactP1: If you contact me by email or phone, the information you provide is processed to handle your enquiry and related correspondence. Please do not send confidential health information unencrypted by email.
Legal.contactP2: Particularly sensitive personal data (e.g. health data) are processed only insofar as you provide them voluntarily and this is necessary for the enquiry or counselling. Protecting such data is a high priority.
Legal.hostingText: The website is hosted on Vercel. When pages are accessed, technically necessary connection data (e.g. IP address, time, requested URL, browser and device information) may be processed in server logs insofar as this is required for operation, security and error analysis. Storage does not follow a principle of “we store nothing”, but the principle of necessity and the host’s settings.
Legal.fontsText: Web fonts used for display are embedded at build time and delivered via hosting. Fonts are not loaded directly from Google servers when the page is accessed. No analytics, advertising or social-media tracking tools are currently used.
Legal.cookiesText: No tracking cookies are set for marketing purposes. Technically necessary hosting or browser functions may store temporary technical data.
Legal.retentionText: Contact-related data are retained only as long as needed to handle the enquiry, any follow-up questions or statutory retention obligations.
Legal.rightsText: Under Swiss data protection law you have in particular the right to access, rectify and erase your personal data, as well as the right to restrict or object to processing where the legal requirements are met. Please send requests to the contact address above.
Legal.changesText: This privacy policy may be updated if the website offer or legal requirements change. The version published on this page applies.
